headline: Clinton order expands the President's Council on Counter-Narcotics and gives it a new name.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier order, Executive Order 12992, that set up the President's Council on Counter-Narcotics. Based on its title, it adds to the council and changes its name. No summary was provided, so the specific new members and the new name are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal officials who serve on the council
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the council's name and expands it, which likely adds members or roles.
